nom: Thayers Alcohol-Free Witch Hazel Facial Toner

avis.texte: A very pleasant toner with a delicate fragrance of roses, cleans nicely the skin and leaves a refreshing feeling. I always buy this product.

I've been using witch hazel for decades and this new formula is not as good as their previous one. My skin does not feel as soft and feels more dry, also there is no fragrance of witch hazel at all and the rose smells different too. . I bought another brand online and I can't wait for it to arrive. I will be dumping this one out as soon as it gets here. Very disappointed that Thayer's sold out to L'Oreal and they changed all their witch hazel products.
Lightly scented but doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Cleanses and balances pores.
I was looking everywhere for a good balanced toner and am happy to say you solved my mystery hunt.
I've been using this toner for years. It's not too harsh and it doesn't burn or irritate my skin.

This was my first toner and it's helped me a lot with my dry skin. I had a skin rash when I was younger and it made my skin really thin and sensitive. This helps make my moisturizer last longer, which is beneficial during extreme temperatures, and my skin no longer gets flaky. I've had this bottle for around 4 months and still have over half of it. Highly recommend for recovering skin.

avis.titre: Works Well but the smell is awful!
avis.texte: I love Thayer's 2% AHA toner so I decided to try this version. I like the way it works but the smell is sickening to me. Since I am rubbing it all on & around my nose I cannot stomach it.
It smells divine! I use it on my face, armpits and sweaty areas to help clear my pores in those areas. Its my favorite toner

avis.titre: This is my new go-to toner that I use daily.
avis.texte: This toner is hydrating, works well, and doesn't irritate my skin. I love the rose petal light scent.
I've never used witch hazel before and I really like this for a first time buy. Smells really good and leaves my face feeling soft and smooth. Doesn't irritate my skin.

I love this witch hazel! I use it on my face daily, as a cleanser and toner. Instead of rinsing my face with harsh tap water, I use this as water and it's perfect to remove makeup and dirt. I also use this product on my intimate area, it's extremely safe for the skin and removes dirt on a deeper level and keeps me feeling refreshed during the day!
This product kinda made me break out but I used it on my legs instead and it works pretty well there so overall it's a pretty good product.
amazing toner! hydrates very well; its a staple in my skincare routine

This rose petal tóner works all skin problems; I was bitten by a mosquito on my eye lid and it causes me to have a red bump on my eye lid and it was SO ITCHY. I desperately look into my beauty products and I recalled that this toner has NO alcohol. I put a bit of it on a cotton round and GUES WHAT? It WORKED. I was very cautious of not putting it into the eye or the inside eye lid. I RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT.

this is a staple product. I've always loved what witch hazel did for my skin but i hate the smell. THIS HAS NO SMELL!! and it doesn't burn. it's truly the best and I'll probably never use another toner. ever.

I have been having a lot of breakouts over the past few months. Nothing was working, someone suggested witch hazel. I was skeptical I didn't think it would work. It has worked and I've only been using it less than a week! I've seen results instantly! I have had no new breakouts and it's even getting rid of my stubborn old breakouts! I'm so happy I found this and will continue to use it! Made me more confident in my own skin!

I use this toner every morning on my face neck and decolletage. It feels refreshing and I definitely see the evenness over time. These bottles last forever. I prefer the cucumber scent but I'll use the rose too.
I would get this again, but I think it was a little expensive for the amount.

I love this stuff so far. I feel like it's working. I'll keep using it in hopes of evening out my skin color as I recently did a lot of field work while only rocking a cap for about 4 weeks. I wish that I could update everyone!

This is the first toner that I have ever used. It has great reviews and I can see why. It has definitely helped my skin clear up and has made my pores better. I like the feeling of it after I apply it doesn't feel drying.

i love love this product for my acne. it visibly got rid of the stubborn acne on my cheeks and chin. it reduced my acne scarring by a little bit. however, i do recommend putting moisturizer right after applying this toner because it can be a little drying.
After immidiate use of this product, my face would always turn really red and hot, which was very uncomfortable. Not worth it.

I saw all of the good reviews and decided to try this out, however all it did after I used it was it would 1. Leave my face really red and warm and 2. Started leaving dry patches on my face, so just be careful.

Yall… i really, really wanted to love this product! I thought the alcohol free would be perfect for me since i do have oily skin. Not the case here. Even though Breakouts typically arent my thing, a week after using this i started getting hormonal sized acne bumps on my cheeks. They hurt really bad and left dark spots. I used about 1.5 more weeks to see if i was just going through a purging phase?? But sadly, my skin never adjusted.. My face hated this stuff. Back to good molecules i go!

I have very sensitive skin that reacts violently to high-end chemically fragranced luxury brands. This is the only brand my loves - the unscented version. Cleans, refreshes and moisturizes. My all in one. I don't use serums and cream moisturizers, other than SPF. No clogged pores, breakouts. Keeping it simple. My skin is happy and it glows! I hope Ulta continues to keep this product on their shelves, though it appears they are gradually phasing thisout in favor of the luxury brands.

avis.titre: Didn't work for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I was hopeful this would work for me since it was unscented but after 3 days I started breaking out. My cheeks were also itchy after using product.
I like this witch hazel, surprisingly. It left my skin pretty plump and moisturized, but still tends to sting my skin. 4 stars, otherwise it's good.

I've used this Toner for YEARS and have LOVED IT! Until I repurchased in 2024 and they've changed to Tap water from Purified- they've gone to Aloe EXTRACT when it used to be the inner filet juice of the plant. Natural fragrance is now Fragrance... really disappointing overall. used to be a great value for the product and now it's just like everything else. Less effective and costs more. Do better Thayers.

This does remove any unwanted dirt and make up that didnt get removed with a cleanser. Although before using, I tested it out on my wrist and had no reaction. Once I started using it on my face for a few days, I noticed I began breaking out. Not my typical breakouts, but under the skin and painful like cystic acne! Once my skin calmed down, I tested again but my face reacted the same. Wasn't for me.

avis.titre: I will never use anything else!
avis.texte: I am an Asian woman in my early 30's with oily skin and definitely some redness due to trying to control the oil. I've never been able to wear make up (high end, non-comedogenic) consistently because it would always cause more breakouts. I've done prescription acne treatments in my 20's, and while my cystic acne is gone, I still get the fun little ones around my jaw/chin and lips. I've been using Clarins products for the last 3-4 years because I love the quality and the smell. Started reading about this super cheap witch hazel alternative and decided to give it a try. When I tell you this stuff was a game changer, believe it! Within the first week of use, I was able to wear make up all day every day without additional breakouts. It has cut down the oil on my face, has healed previous pimples flawlessly, and has significantly reduced the redness because of how anti-inflammatory and gentle it is on the skin. As a woman of color who was on the verge of accepting that I'd just have acne til the day I die, I could not recommend this product enough. For all my POC girlies with oily skin - GET THIS STUFF!!!

Oily female here with acne prone to hyperpigmentation and noticeable pores/ blackheads around chin and nose. I never used a toner until this one and I'm glad that for my skin care journey this was my first to try. After cleansing in the shower this toner sets my skin for serums, sleep masks, or daily moisturizers. My pores in select places around my face have gotten smaller and my skin has a constantly dewy/healthy appearance. Furthermore any hyperpigmentation I get from acne breakouts fade much faster than without this product. Affordable, effective, and environmentally conscious.
This is my first time using this toner & I love it! It feels so soft & smooth when applied on my face with no harsh chemical feel. And I love the rose smell!

I love this product, I have very oily skin and my face is scarred but for whatever reason this product works amazing. I live by it that i go through 2 bottles a year, due to sun exposure this product has helped alot, i apply it everyday and it also helps with your scalp.

avis.titre: Results in less than a week!!
avis.texte: Ive only ever used one other toner in my life and i felt like it didnt make any difference so i dropped it from my skincare. I dont do much for skincare anyways, just wash, maybe a serum or two, and then moisturizer with SPF. I bought this just to try it out and it works wonderfully! After just 4 days, i really feel like my pores appear so much smaller and has reduced my redness! I am obsessed. It works so well, ive added this into my daily routine and sometimes even in my evening routine as well. Theres no harsh smell, the price is great considering the effects, and my skin is glowy, clear, and smooth. I use this and then apply a vitamin C serum so that my skin is extra glowy. Id recommend for sure!
i have oily-combination skin and this is AMAZING i use it morning and night and it cleared up my forehead texture and acne. it does dry skin a little but that's perfect for oily skin.

I have dry acne prone skin, and after seeing people praise this all over I bought it (unscented). I've used half the bottle, and while I wouldn't say it's made my skin worse, I've noticed zero improvements.

This has been my tried and true toner for years and always gets the job done. It doesn't dry out my skin and leaves my skin feeling clean and refresh. I have combination skin and this is the only toner that doesn't dry out my skin !

If i had to ditch all my skin care products and keep just one, it would be this toner. Its so gentle but leaves my skin feeling so fresh and clean. I use it twice a day and sometimes more when its warm out.

I've never been a huge toner fan as I don't find they usually do anything. I tried this one it has a pleasant scent, doesn't sting my face and doesnt leave it feeling dry. I don't find it super hydrating but I think the aloe calms my skin a bit!

avis.titre: Good Toner for Really Oily Skin
avis.texte: If you have really oily skin, this is a great toner because of the astringent nature of the witch hazel and smells nice because of the rose water. The rose water provides a soothing effect but is not quite enough for the dry spots on my skin. In all honesty, unless you have unmanageably oily skin and need an additional step in your routine to keep your face more matte throughout the day, it is okay to skip this.
This toner was very gentle on my skin. It removed leftover dirt on my skin and was also very soothing.

I received this product for free from TopBox in exchange for my honest review. I use a different toner twice a day and have used the other brand for the last 20 years so I wasn't sure if I would like this new brand of toner but I am happy to say I love it and it has become my new favorite toner! I like that it is alcohol free so it won't dry out my skin which I have experienced in the past. It also leaves my skin feeling super clean and soft to the touch. I have sensitive skin and this does not bother my skin at all. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a great toner that will have your skin looking and feeling amazing with every use. #trywithtopbox #freeproduct

I was given the opportunity to test and review Thayers Natural Remdies Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Formula Facial Toner 355ml. I was excited to try this product as I am a fan of Witch Hazel for my skin. I found that I applied the product to my face whenever I felt that I needed to calm my skin, or I needed a pick me up, or my face just felt dirty and it was more efficient to tone then wash. The product had a soft pleasant scent of roses and witch hazel. It was soothing but it did cause my skin to feel a bit tight and dried out. That was fixable with some moisturizer though.
This toner left my skin very clean as it removed any residue that was left behind by my cleanser. This left my skin prepped for moisturizer.
A good product that i did not know and that i am learning to discover! He is very good ! #trywithtopbox #freeproduct

I was given the opportunity to try this #freeproduct - Thayer's toner from #topbox for my honest review. This toner has a slight scent of rose and is so absolutely soothing to use after the shower or to even remove makeup. My husband has been caught a few times using this even after shaving so it's not only for women! I seen this on store shelves but was skeptical to try but this could be my absolute favourite toner now! Thanks for the opportunity, if you haven't tried it yet it's time to grab yourself some Thayer's toner and add it to your self care routine.

I received this product free from Topbox Circle and Thayers in exchange for my honest review. When I saw that this toner included Witch Hazel, I was a bit apprehensive, as I was expecting a very astringent and tingly toner. However, this Thayers toner was a pleasant surprise, as it wasn't astringent, but soothing. I enjoyed the rose water and aloe in the toner; the rose water gave it a light floral scent and the aloe made it moisturizing.

I was sent Thayers Natural Remedies Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Formula Facial Toner for free from Topbox circle in exchange for my honest review. I use toner twice daily - morning and evening- and was excited to try this one. I was impressed by the way it made my skin feel very clean and fresh. It helped remove any traces of makeup that were left after cleansing. The formula was gentle and not harsh. There was no strong smell. The bottle was sturdy and easy to open. I will definitely add this product to my to repurchase list and recommend it to others. #trywithtopbox #freeproduct

avis.titre: Not the Right Product For Me But Could Be For You!
avis.texte: I received this as a #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox. I used it daily for about a week and it made my skin was feel smooth and hydrated. After that week, I noticed my skin started to break out. In the past, I have had reactions to Aloe based products so, I think it just means it wasn't the right product for my skin but I can see it working for someone else.

This toner smells like fresh rose petals -- I can't get enough! It also does a great job purifying the skin and removing any impurities and makeup residue that stayed on my skin after cleansing. I also love that this toner is alcohol free and does not dry out my skin like other toners I've tried. It is also an affordable product.

This toner blend perfectly suited for oily-combination skin, it combines the clarifying touch of witch hazel with the calming embrace of aloe vera. It's as if my skin gets a gentle, refreshing melody every time I use it.

I was super excited to try this tonera and have been using it for the past month. This toner goes on like a gentle breeze, leaving my skin refreshed, not parched. I feel like my pores are shrinking while my skin gets this soothing, cool vibe.

avis.titre: This is my go to toner
avis.texte: I am not too big on toners and often skip it in my skincare. I feel like it leaves my skin feeling either sticky or dry. But this Thayers Witch Hazel Toner is pretty good! It leaves my skin feeling smooth and moisturized. The rose petal scent is amazing as well!

I received this #freeproduct to #trywithtopbox in exchange of my review. I love it, I have sensitive skin and I have no issues with dryness after washing with the face wash and then using the toner. I would buy them both.

So I have never used facial toner before and having this product as the first to try was very interesting as I've been curious about it. This is a great product for sensitive skin and I have very sensitive skin. No drying alcohol or funky smells or burning skin sensations. Plus my face feels really soft and smooth after using. This is an A+.
What a great toner that smells amazing. It brings freshness to the skin. I use it after cleaning my face and really feel like my pores are liking it !

Thayers Natural Remedies Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Facial Toner, in its generous 355ml size, has become a must-have for my skincare routine. Its natural formula, featuring witch hazel and aloe vera, provides soothing relief to my dry skin. This toner not only cleanses and refreshes but also reduces redness and inflammation. It's a cost-effective choice, and its gentle floral scent adds a touch of luxury to my daily routine. In sum, if you're looking for a budget-friendly, skin-loving toner that helps combat dryness, this one is a winner.

Thayer's which hazel toner with aloe vera has become my favourite skin care product. I normally don't use toner but decided to give it a try. I have been using it for about two weeks now and am really impressed with the results. This toner removes extra makeup and dirt that my cleanser has missed. It tightens my skin and leaves it feeling very moisturized and healthy. It also make my pores appear less visible especially when I wear makeup. I especially love bringing it to the gym as I can quickly freshen-up and clean my face on-the-go after my sweaty workout! Very happy with this product!

I love this toner. My skin is pretty sensitive and I have had no problems since I have been using this everyday. My skin is so clean, soft, and looks great! It smells really nice, like roses. Its mild and makes my skin feel really nice. I really like it. It works really well with the soap as well. I definitely recommend!

I recieved this as a free sample from #topboxcircle in exchange for my review, and have been using it twice a day for almost a month. I've heard about this toner for years and had doubts. As someone with sensitive skin, I am nervous to try new products, espeically a toner. I found this super refreshing, it applies easily and dries without your skin feeling sticky. My serums apply well afterward too! I would totally restock again when i'm done this bottle.

avis.titre: Mostly enjoyed, bit not a fan of the scent
avis.texte: Received this product free via Topbox Circle and have been using it for a little over a month. Was a step I wasn't previously using in my routine. I mainly used it on a cotton ball, at night after the Thayers cleanser, thinking that bit of extra cleansing was good after sunscreen and build up from being out and about. I did NOT enjoy the rose scent. But that's just not a scent I enjoy, not necessarily a problem with the product. I did usually see it had removed a bit of dirt/skin/whatever on the ball and I enjoyed the feel of the product. I would considered purchasing this once I'm done the bottle, just in an unscented or differently scented version.

I received the Rose Petal Facial Toner to test and absolutely love it. First off the scent is lovely. Not too strong or overpowering. It is alcohol-free however you still get that refreshing tingly feeling after using. I use daily morning and evening after cleansing. In the morning it's a great pick me up and leaves my skin feeling super hydrated, soft and refreshed. It does not leave my skin feeling tight or dry at all. In the evening I like that it gets any traces of leftover makeup for an extra clean feeling. My skin has been looking clearer with less breakouts and it has also helped with my skin tone and making my pores look smaller.

avis.titre: Great facial Toner for your skin
avis.texte: It is really soft and gentle Toner based on Rose Water with unique blend of Aloe Vera ans with hazel growing that are natural remedies. It is clean and provide natural glow to your skin.

This is a nice rosey toner that I'd pretty much water and glycerin to me. It's not very hydrating but isn't stripping either. It's not a bad formula, but I feel in this day and age there are just so many more hydrating toners out there.

This is the best toner I've ever used, and I've tried quite a few. My skin tone has greatly improved and it's well balanced. My skin is hydrated and smooth after using this and looks full of life. It absorbs into the skin very quickly and has a lovely, fresh scent to it. This product is quite literally like magic and I couldn't be happier with how its transformed my skin. I highly recommend this!

I reall love the rose petal fragrance to this Toner. It is an aloe Vera witch hazel formula that is alcohol free. 98% natural origin ingredients. My face does feel toned however it didn't minimize my pores or make my skin look different with a short amount of time. Hopefully with further use I will see some results. My face feels soft. It is a very gentle Toner. It made my skin feel great.

I really love this witch hazel facial toner. I use it after my shower to help my skin from drying out, and I love the very light scent. I apply it directly to my hands because I hate the feeling of cotton pads, and love the feeling of gliding this product on my skin. It makes my skin feel really soft and hydrated.

I love how well this toner absorbs into the skin and how hydrating it is. It has a beautiful rose scent, but it can be a bit strong and nauseates me just a tad. That's just me and rose scented products though. I love that it's made from 98% natural ingredients and offers soothing benefits thanks to Aloe vera and witch hazel. I really love this toner and how it feels on my skin, but would get the unscented formula next time.
I received this from TopBox Circle and Thayers and really loved it! The packaging is really cute and I absolutely loved the witch hazel scent!

I really enjoyed this product I love that its smells like aloe vera . Was very easily applied on face and It did not leave any stickiness on face .After using it for 3 weeks my face my pores have reduced. My face feels super clean after using it. I would definitely recommend it as a morning and night routine.
I got this a couple weeks ago from #topbox circle. This product makes my skin hydration and put on the make up product more easier.
I'm using this toner as part of my morning routine. I feels nice on my skin. It's not drying up my skin which I'm happy about.

I have major issues with product sensitivities whete I sometimes break out in a sore rash so I was super excited to be sent this product free to try. It smells like fresh roses. I used this one to two times every day following the Thayers face cleanser for the past 4 weeks. The size is very generous and in all the time I have hardly used any. It absorbed well and make my shin feel very soft. I plan to repurchase. #freeproduct

I love how this product has aloe vera. It feels extra calming on the skin and the scent is not overpowering at all. I will consider purchasing this product in the future since I received this as a free product using #topboxcircle.

Thayers Natural Remdies Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Formula Facial Toner was received as a free product as a part of topbox circle program. The toner feels incredibly good on my sensitive skin. It doesn't feel it dries the skin and I barely noticed very light and pleasant scent of roses. While using the toner I had less breakouts and my skin is more softer than just using a moisturizer alone. I love to see only positive results using this product. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

avis.titre: Thayers Facial Toner with Aloe and Witch Hazel
avis.texte: Recieved Thayers Facial Toner with Witch Hazel and Aloe Vera in exchange for my honest opinion. This toner is advertised as a balanced and gentle formula that helps to cleanse, tone and moisturize your skin. This formula is alcohol free, gluten free, phthalate free and paraben free and uses aloe and witch hazel grown on a family farm. I put this onto a facial cleaning pad and ran it over my face in the morning. I experienced a cooling sensation and noticed the smell of rose petals. I love the smell of roses. I did not see any removal of dirt from my face. I did experience the moisturizing effects of this formula. I think its a good addition to my morning routine and look forward to continuing to use it. What I liked the most is the scent, moisturizing effect and that it is made from 98% natural ingredients. I also like that it is gentle on my skin and doesn't irritate.
I love everything about this toner! Great smell, does not irritate my sensitive skin and as a pleasant bonus, reduced my blemishes. A must-have in my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Thayers-Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Formula Facial Toner
avis.texte: I was fortunate to be able to try the Thayers Natural Remedies - Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Formula Facial Toner through the Topbox Circle (#trywithtopbox) program. I have been using this product after using the Thayers Natural Remedies - PH Balancing Daily Cleanser on a regular basis day and night for the past three weeks. It is very gentle with a soft scent of rose petals which is most pleasant. Although I have very oily skin it does not tend to leave my skin feeling oily or over dry. It seems that in the morning, my face still tends to be relatively oil free which is a most definite positive. I will be purchasing this product in the future. The fact that a full size container was provided made reviewing the product that much easier - small sample tubes do not allow for an accurate picture of the value of a product. I would highly recommend this product. #freeproduct

I received this product from Topbox so I could try it and give an honest opinion. This toner is very light yet effective. It does a great job on the pores and leaves the skin fresh and tinkling. It also has a pleasant fresh smell.

I got to try Thayers' Natural Remedies Witch Hazel Aloe Vera Formula Facial Toner for an honest review. This is the second product from Thayers' line of products I got to try, and I will say that I'm impressed. I found that it did remove any oil off my face. Sometimes with toners, I've used, I have found they feel harsh on my skin after applying but this on the other hand has been very gentle on my skin, while getting cleaning my face. The scent of the rose water is very pleasant. Knowing there is witch hazel in it, with rose water, makes my face feel like I'm getting the pamper spa treatment. I've been enjoying using this every day.

avis.titre: Thayers Natural Remdies Witch Hazel Facial Toner
avis.texte: I got this product free in the mail in exchange for my review. I used the toner after I used the cleanser from this brand. My skin feels soft and smooth. It feels refreshing and I didn't breakout.
I absolutely love the way this feels on my skin because I have oily and dry skin; but thus makes my skin feel hydrated. I would definitely recommend this product if you want smooth gorgeous skin!!

Thayers has been around for over 175 years! I have been using Thayers aloe, witch hazel, rose water + alcohol-free toner for many years. I love the simplicity of these formulas. They don't have a million ingredients and get straight to the point. 🌹This is my first time using the Thayers pH Balancing Daily Cleaner (5% aloe vera) and it's been very effective at washing off my sunscreen and makeup. This cleanser contains some really nice ingredients: It has an aloe and glycerin base + vitamin C, salicylic acid and sodium hyaluronate. 🌹Thayers Facial Toner has 11 ingredients with glycerin, witch hazel, aloe and rose flower water at the top of the list. It includes a rose-like fragrance that does not affect my sensitive skin. The toner has been a staple in my skincare routine for many years and I love it!

I received this amazing toner #freeproduct #trywithtopbox to try and give my opinion. I've used it a few times and I already noticed how my skin feels sift and refreshed. It smells so good. And love how 98% of the ingredients are natural. Amazing product

J'ai reçu de la part de Topbox Circle le tonique visage de Thayers. Je l'utilise plusieurs fois par jour. Le soir pour nettoyer ma peau et le jour tout simplement pour rafraîchir ma peau. Ce tonique est sans alcool. Il n'irrite pas la peau même en l'utilisant plusieurs fois par jour. Il a un agréable parfum de rose que j'aime beaucoup. Merci pour la découverte. #trywithtopbox #freeproduct
The product was really good. I received the product by topbokcircle and I try. Its smell really good but just a Little bit too Much for me
i love this toner it balances my skin and smells just like lavender it is also very moisturizing and feels very gentle on skin i definitely recommend this toner!!

#TopBox #freeproduct Receive this product for free for an honest review.. I was a little hesitant and using this product for the first time but definitely changed my mind after using it for a week. From the way it made my skin feel to the texture to the smell of the product. Definitely my number one choice for my next purchase Adding this to my skin care routine game changer!!

This is an okay toner. It didn't have any adverse effect on my skin. The rose scent is pretty strong but I don't mind it. I have some toners that are more moisturizing and seem to help more but this isn't bad. I received it free from topbox in exchange for my unbiased review
I have dry sensititve skin and this works well for me as its alchohol-free. I find that wet the cotton pads with the toner is better that just use it itself. I like to use it before my night cream.

I am in love with this toner. I recieved this as a #freeproduct from topbox. I have been using it regularly at night from last two weeks. My skin feels really clean and smooth. It very refreshing and smells amazing.

I received this product for free from Topbox Circle and this is my honest review. I'm new-ish to toner but I think this will stay in my cleansing routine. My face feels more moisturized since and I love that there are no smell.

I love Thayer's toners! My only complaint is this particular scent is really off-putting. I purchased expecting a cucumber-melon scent, but this product is purely cucumber. It's my own fault for assuming there'd be melon notes to add sweetness, but I just really dislike the earthy, vegetal scent of the toner. Some people, however, might enjoy the smell, so I realize this is a subjective issue. Apart from the scent, the product works well and lives up to the high quality expected of Thayer's toners. I'll stick to the rose scent from here on, though.

I was quickly impress with Thayer's aloe toner! Tho I am not a fan of the original witch hazel as I found it to be too strong and drying for me this one seems to be the complete opposite! It leaves my face feeling very refreshed and hydrated and looks great too! I use it after removing makeup just before my serum and moisturizer nightly can also be used daily.
Something about this toner is very addictive! I think it's that wonderful feeling of being refreshed after every use… It also feels great on the skin and moisturizes gently. Love it!!

I used to always use high end toner from major brands. Used this once and I was hooked. Affordable, cooling and smells fantastic. I use coconut water and cucumber scents, just a great product that flys under the radar.

I received this #freeproduct in exchange for an honest review from #trywithtopbox so here we go! The smell is very refreshing, not too strong. It really felt like it helped clean up the makeup and oil that got missed when I washed my face and didn't sting or make my skin feel tight or dry at all. It prepped my skin perfectly for my serum and the rest of my routine. I would definitely reach for this again and definitely recommend if you are on the fence to just give it a try!
I liked using this product. I'm used to toners that melt "heat" the figure after application. I was very surprised by the softness of this product. My face feels clean and light after use. I adore.
